name: storage_app
label: SciTeX Storage
subtitle: Fleet disk-usage triage: scan, sweep, archive, find duplicates
about: Browse per-directory disk usage across hosts, backed by scitex-storage's read-only scan(). First scaffold: proves the scitex-hub mounting contract works end-to-end with real data, not the full disk-treemap UI yet.
description: SciTeX Storage is a fleet storage triage tool. This GUI plugin surfaces scitex-storage's read-only, stat-only directory scan as a browsable table (size + inode usage per top-level child of a path), the first step toward a full multi-host treemap view with agentic judgment (orphaned junk vs. legitimate data) layered on top.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: Browse per-directory size + inode usage (read-only scan)
Inspect any path via ?path= (defaults to the user's home directory)
